scope: Proposed 88-card first editorial batch; not the installed release library
instructions: Review every included Spanish/English/example, regional assertion and register against the exact fingerprint.
Record corrections in source first, regenerate the inventory and review the changed fingerprints.
An empty decision is unreviewed. Only real attributed human decisions may be entered into review-ledger.json.
This packet does not approve grammar outside cards, generated pronunciation, assets or recording rights.
The full 1392-card library remains bundled. Releasing only these cards requires separate runtime/migration/asset integration.
